caption:
Tip of the week: turn from your mid-back, not your low back. 🔄

Your low back is built for stability and only rotates a little. Most of your turn should come from your hips and mid-back.
✅ Kneel tall, keep your hips still and let your ribs turn
✅ Eyes follow your hand, breathe out as you open
❌ Don't lean back or twist from the low back to find more range

Save this and share it with your playing partner.
